mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student (name, no, gender, phone, id_card, is_college, address, degree, graduation_date, clazz_id, violation_count, violation_score, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{no}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{idCard}, #{isCollege}, #{address}, #{degree}, #{graduationDate}, #{clazzId}, #{violationCount}, #{violationScore}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE student SET violation_count = violation_count + 1, violation_score = violation_score + #{score}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: select (case degree when 1 then '初中' when 2 then '高中' when 3 then '大专' when 4 then '本科' when 5 then '硕士' when 6 then '博士' else '其他' end) as name, count(*) as value from student group by degree order by degree
SELECT s.*, c.name AS clazzName FROM student s LEFT JOIN clazz c ON s.clazz_id = c.id WHERE s.id = #{id}
select c.name as clazzName, count(s.id) as total from student s left join clazz c on s.clazz_id = c.id group by s.clazz_id, c.name order by total desc
